Porter provides ADB access for your apps through compatible Shizuku APIs.

- Install **porter-v…-release.apk** for Porter.
- Install **porter-compat-v…-release.apk** only for apps that require the original Shizuku permission. Porter Compatibility requires Porter and cannot be installed alongside Shizuku.

[Setup guide](https://d4rken-org.github.io/porter/setup.html) · [Compatibility guide](https://d4rken-org.github.io/porter/compatibility.html)

The APKs share the signing certificate listed below. `SHA256SUMS` contains download checksums; `build-info.json` identifies the source commits and CI run.
